sources.title: Abbott-Smith Manual Greek Lexicon — maintained TEI project
sources.claim_limit: May establish edition identity, public-domain status of the marked-up lexicon, release/completion history, and the rule to prefer the checked/current release over raw OCR.

sources.title: Abbott-Smith s.v. οἰκονόμος
sources.claim_limit: May support household/estate manager and broader steward/administrator range and Abbott-Smith's explicit application to Christians generally in 1 Peter 4:10. Does not establish a church office in 4:10.
sources.rights_note: Underlying Abbott-Smith 1922 lexicon is public domain; mirror is an inspection route. No proprietary surrounding lexicon text is to be republished.

sources.title: Abbott-Smith s.v. λόγιον
sources.claim_limit: May support oracle/divine-utterance lexical range and the 1 Peter 4:11 citation. Does not by itself establish a doctrine of inspiration or make every Christian utterance canonical Scripture.

sources.title: Abbott-Smith s.v. πύρωσις
sources.claim_limit: May support literal burning and metaphorical refining/trial-by-fire range, including 1 Peter 4:12 and LXX Proverbs 27:21 background. Cannot identify Malachi 3 as Peter's source.

sources.title: Abbott-Smith s.v. κτίστης
sources.claim_limit: May support founder/creator range and creator-of-God use at 1 Peter 4:19. Does not make every extra-biblical κτίστης a cosmic-creation title.

sources.title: Abbott-Smith s.v. ἐγκομβόομαι
sources.claim_limit: May support put-on/gird-on clothing imagery in 1 Peter 5:5 and etymological garment background. Does not prove a unique exact slave-apron reconstruction.

sources.title: Moulton–Milligan s.v. ἐγκομβόομαι
sources.claim_limit: May support that Moulton–Milligan found no instance of the rare verb in their documentary sources and cited a later lexical/comic parallel for girding something on oneself. This negative corpus observation does not prove no ancient example existed.
sources.rights_note: Underlying 1914–1929 work is public domain; public-domain scan route separately verified.

sources.title: Abbott-Smith s.v. ἀντίδικος
sources.claim_limit: May support opponent-in-a-lawsuit/adversary range and application to 1 Peter 5:8. Does not establish a literal courtroom scene.

sources.title: Moulton–Milligan s.v. ἀντίδικος (p. 47)
sources.claim_limit: May support common legal-word documentary usage and Moulton–Milligan's explicit note that wider adversary use fits 1 Peter 5:8. Does not establish a heavenly-court scenario.

sources.title: Abbott-Smith s.v. σθενόω
sources.claim_limit: May support strengthen as the lexical meaning and the 1 Peter 5:10 reference. Cannot resolve whether the form is present in every witness; textual presence remains a textual-critical question.

sources.title: Abbott-Smith s.v. συνεκλεκτός
sources.claim_limit: May support chosen-together-with/co-elect range and the 1 Peter 5:13 feminine form. Does not identify the historical referent as a particular woman or a church.

sources.title: Moulton & Milligan, Vocabulary of the Greek Testament — public-domain scan route
sources.claim_limit: May establish the public-domain status, 1914–1929 publication identity and 705-page full-PDF route. Individual lexical claims require an inspected entry/excerpt or page locator.
